# Extend DaggerML

This path is for integration engineers adding execution backends, adapters,
literal codecs, or packages that supply them. It documents extension contracts;
using a built-in integration does not require reading these pages.

## Start here

- [Extension model](extension-model.qmd): where delayed authoring,
  adapters, executors, codecs, and the runtime meet.
- [Write an adapter](write-adapter.qmd): add a transport boundary.
- [Write an executor](write-executor.qmd): add backend-specific work.
- [Plugin API](plugin-api.qmd): package discovery and lookup rules.

## Browse by goal

- Concepts: [adapters and executors](adapters-and-executors.qmd),
  [codecs](codecs.qmd), [remote integrations](remote-integrations.qmd),
  and [plugin registration](plugin-registration.qmd).
- Guides: [shared codecs](write-shared-codec.qmd),
  [package an integration](package-integration.qmd), and
  [test an integration](test-integration.qmd).
- Reference: [adapter operations](adapter-operations.qmd),
  [executor lifecycle](executor-lifecycle.qmd),
  [codec contracts](codec-contracts.qmd), and
  [built-in integrations](built-in-integrations.qmd).

```{python}
from daggerml.contrib.api import funkify
from daggerml.contrib.testing import defunkify


@funkify
def double(_dag, value):
    return value.value() * 2


assert defunkify(double)(None, 21) == 42
```

The implementation namespace is `daggerml.contrib`, but this documentation is
organized by integration task rather than package name.
